question: List all employee names.
sql: SELECT employee_name FROM employees;

question: List all department names.
sql: SELECT department_name FROM departments;

question: List all product names.
sql: SELECT product_name FROM products;

question: List all customer names.
sql: SELECT customer_name FROM customers;

question: List all cities where customers are located.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT city FROM customers;

question: Show the regions where our locations are.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT region FROM locations;

question: List all product categories.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT category FROM products;

question: Show the names of all employees with their salaries.
sql: SELECT employee_name, salary FROM employees;

question: List all order ids with their statuses.
sql: SELECT order_id, status FROM orders;

question: List all sale dates in the sales table.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT sale_date FROM sales;

question: Which employees earn more than one hundred thousand?
sql: SELECT employee_name FROM employees WHERE salary > 100000;

question: Which products cost less than fifty dollars?
sql: SELECT product_name FROM products WHERE price < 50;

question: Which customers are from New York?
sql: SELECT customer_name FROM customers WHERE city = 'New York';

question: Which sales were made on 2024-05-01?
sql: SELECT sale_id FROM sales WHERE sale_date = '2024-05-01';

question: Which orders have been cancelled?
sql: SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE status = 'Cancelled';

question: Which employees were hired after 2020?
sql: SELECT employee_name FROM employees WHERE hire_date > '2020-01-01';

question: Which products belong to the Electronics category?
sql: SELECT product_name FROM products WHERE category = 'Electronics';

question: Which departments have a budget over two million?
sql: SELECT department_name FROM departments WHERE budget > 2000000;

question: Which locations are in the Midwest region?
sql: SELECT city FROM locations WHERE region = 'Midwest';

question: Which sales generated more than five hundred in revenue?
sql: SELECT sale_id FROM sales WHERE revenue > 500;

question: List employee names along with their department names.
sql: SELECT e.employee_name, d.department_name FROM employees e JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.department_id;

question: Which employees work in the Engineering department?
sql: SELECT e.employee_name FROM employees e JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.department_id WHERE d.department_name = 'Engineering';

question: List each department with the city where it is located.
sql: SELECT d.department_name, l.city FROM departments d JOIN locations l ON d.location_id = l.location_id;

question: Show each sale with the name of the employee who made it.
sql: SELECT s.sale_id, e.employee_name FROM sales s JOIN employees e ON s.employee_id = e.employee_id;

question: Show each sale with the product name sold.
sql: SELECT s.sale_id, p.product_name FROM sales s JOIN products p ON s.product_id = p.product_id;

question: Which customers have purchased products from the Electronics category?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_name FROM customers c JOIN sales s ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id JOIN products p ON s.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.category = 'Electronics';

question: Which employees made a sale on 2024-05-01?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT e.employee_name FROM employees e JOIN sales s ON e.employee_id = s.employee_id WHERE s.sale_date = '2024-05-01';

question: Show the names of the employee and customer for every sale.
sql: SELECT s.sale_id, e.employee_name, c.customer_name FROM sales s JOIN employees e ON s.employee_id = e.employee_id JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id;

question: List the products sold and the department of the employee who sold them.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.product_name, d.department_name FROM sales s JOIN products p ON s.product_id = p.product_id JOIN employees e ON s.employee_id = e.employee_id JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.department_id;

question: Show order details with product names and quantities.
sql: SELECT o.order_id, p.product_name, o.quantity FROM orders o JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.product_id;

question: How many employees work in each department?
sql: SELECT d.department_name, COUNT(e.employee_id) AS employee_count FROM employees e JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.department_id GROUP BY d.department_name;

question: What is the total revenue per product category?
sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(s.revenue) AS total_revenue FROM sales s JOIN products p ON s.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.category;

question: How many customers are in each city?
sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY city;

question: How many products are there in each category?
sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products GROUP BY category;

question: What is the total revenue per employee?
sql: SELECT s.employee_id, SUM(s.revenue) AS total_revenue FROM sales s GROUP BY s.employee_id;

question: List employees sorted by salary from highest to lowest.
sql: SELECT employee_name, salary FROM employees ORDER BY salary DESC;

question: List the most expensive products first.
sql: SELECT product_name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC;

question: List customers in alphabetical order.
sql: SELECT customer_name FROM customers ORDER BY customer_name ASC;

question: Show the ten most recent sales.
sql: SELECT sale_id, sale_date FROM sales ORDER BY sale_date DESC LIMIT 10;

question: List employees hired most recently first.
sql: SELECT employee_name, hire_date FROM employees ORDER BY hire_date DESC;

question: How many employees are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM employees;

question: What is the average salary of employees?
sql: SELECT AVG(salary) AS avg_salary FROM employees;

question: What is the total revenue from all sales?
sql: SELECT SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM sales;

question: What is the most expensive product?
sql: SELECT MAX(price) AS max_price FROM products;

question: What is the lowest budget among departments?
sql: SELECT MIN(budget) AS min_budget FROM departments;

question: Which department has the highest average salary?
sql: SELECT d.department_name, AVG(e.salary) AS avg_salary FROM employees e JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.department_id GROUP BY d.department_name ORDER BY avg_salary DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Which employees earn more than the average salary?
sql: SELECT employee_name, salary FROM employees WHERE salary > (SELECT AVG(salary) FROM employees);

question: What is the total revenue per department for departments with over one hundred thousand in revenue?
sql: SELECT d.department_name, SUM(s.revenue) AS total_revenue FROM sales s JOIN employees e ON s.employee_id = e.employee_id JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.department_id GROUP BY d.department_name HAVING SUM(s.revenue) > 100000;

question: Which product has been sold the most times?
sql: SELECT p.product_name, COUNT(*) AS sales_count FROM sales s JOIN products p ON s.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_name ORDER BY sales_count DESC LIMIT 1;

question: How many customers have never placed an order?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_without_orders FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_id IS NULL;
